messages:
maya: Quick shoutout time — huge thanks to @arjun and @shelby for digging into the quantization regressions on the inference job last night. Also big props to @people-ops-bot for the timely page :pray:. Thinking of sending small snack vouchers to remote folks — thoughts?

shelby: Team effort. Arjun traced the weirdness, i just helped validate the fix.

arjun: Couldn’t have done it without the perf traces Lukas sent. And Samira's rollback plan made it painless.

lukas: happy to help. here’s the silly command i ran to repro: ```rprof --tail 5m``` (not a real magic incantation)

samira: The canary rollback was a 2-minute turnaround. People Ops — i’m down for remote vouchers. Also, @kevin spotted the env mismatch that made repro flaky.

people-ops-bot: Poll: "Remote snack vouchers?" Options: :white_check_mark: Yes / :x: No / :sparkles: Surprise me — vote with emoji!

kevin: :raised_hands: Yes please. Also, big love to maya for coordinating the swap between staging and demo envs.

maya: Haha thanks. Small idea — drop one-line kudos below and i’ll compile a micro-newsletter for next week. If you want anonymity for the voucher, DM me.

devops-bot: Incident log & timeline pinned to #incidents-archive — https://redwood.internal/inc/3456 

shelby: Arjun — for staying late. Lukas — for traces. Samira — for rollback plan. Kevin — for the handoff. Maya — for coordinating. :sparkles:

arjun: Really appreciate this team. :heart: Also shoutout to @zoe for keeping the client calm during the hiccup.

zoe: Client stayed calm, snagged a virtual cookie for you all :cookie:

nick: +1 from infra. can confirm the patch dropped p95 by ~120ms on the canary.

maya: Love this energy. I’ll compile the notes and send voucher codes tomorrow (People Ops will distribute). If anyone wants to opt out or stay anonymous, DM me.

samira: Quick Q — could we add a "thank-you" label or tag on PRs so contributors show up in weekly notes?

people-ops-bot: Noted — creating a short form for voucher requests and adding a line to the weekly micro-newsletter workflow.

maya: Final — paste tiny gifs if you want them in the newsletter, otherwise gratitude mode: ON. :gong:
